verdict: Client stuck in provisioning mode after an in-place OS upgrade. Caused by specifying an OEM product key during the upgrade; `Setupcomplete.cmd` is disabled when OEM keys are used, so the post-upgrade client re-registration never completes.
fix: Immediate: exit provisioning mode on the affected client: `Invoke-CimMethod -Namespace root\ccm -ClassName SMS_Client -MethodName SetClientProvisioningMode -Arguments @{ bEnable = $false }` (or set `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\CCM\CcmExec ProvisioningMode` to `false` and restart CcmExec). Preventative: change the upgrade task sequence to use a KMS client setup key, not an OEM key. Keep the OEM key in a separate `Apply Windows Settings` post-upgrade step if it must be preserved.
